fit.rule: Stage 1 fits the unchanged stratified cost/reach squared error without sign projection, at most 150 steps; switch early only if original old AND additional numeric checks pass. Stage 2 uses the same regression plus existing component/joint sign gradient projection for at most 150 steps with a fresh Adam. Unused stage-1 steps do not transfer. Temporary old/new numeric or sign regressions are allowed offline; no per-step or block monotone-correctness guards or backtracking. Check unchanged full v5 train gate after EVERY step and freeze the FIRST full pass. A nonfinite loss/gradient/parameter stops the run with diagnostic logs; it cannot enter development. Log every start prediction and false-feasible/false-infeasible/primary changes. Save the numeric-stage checkpoint. Source files and actors stay unchanged.

train_gate: Call the unchanged v5 train_gate on 540 old plus 432 additional train episodes. Old and new numeric errors remain separately checked: relative MAE<=0.35, required Pearson>=0.70. Original primary recognition, beta=0, zero false-feasible and all selected boundary signs remain mandatory. Preserve full_s2 actual train primary 17/18 and reject its timeout. Temporary regression is never deployment approval.
development_gate: Only after all six final train gates pass, save and CPU-reload all six models and invoke the unchanged original evaluator on the 180 saved development episodes once. Original primary 6/6, zero false-feasible and G4 are unchanged. No repeated development tuning, new development rollouts or final/budget_selection access.
failure_policy: One new, separately approved run only. Preserve every finite failed checkpoint and log; no source overwrite, automatic restart, leftover reuse/transfer, extra rollouts or relaxed final criteria. Any final train failure holds development. This proposal is not authorization for optimizer steps or changed process guards.
protected: beta=0 and final G4/v5 train criteria
authorization_reference: Latest user confirmation of the reviewed v7 plan: 确认. One new 150 numeric + 150 boundary step run per candidate, six candidates <=1800; process monotone guards removed, final gates unchanged.
